name: Nabal (Abigail's first husband)
title: The Foolish Rich Man from Carmel
summary: Nabal was a wealthy man from Maon who conducted his business in Carmel. He was married to the wise and beautiful Abigail, but he himself was known for his harshness and bad behavior. His insult of David nearly led to bloodshed, but it was averted by Abigail's wisdom.

keyEvents.title: Nabal Insults David
keyEvents.description: When David sent his men to ask for food and provisions as repayment for the protection they had given Nabal's shepherds, Nabal rejected them with harsh words and insulted David.

keyEvents.title: David Decides on Revenge
keyEvents.description: Furious over Nabal's insult, David gathered his men and swore to kill every man in Nabal's household.

keyEvents.title: Abigail Intervenes
keyEvents.description: Abigail learned of Nabal's folly and met David with gifts, managing to avert the revenge action through her wisdom and humility.

keyEvents.title: Nabal's Heart Attack and Death
keyEvents.description: When Abigail told Nabal how close he had come to death, his heart became like stone within him. Ten days later, the Lord struck Nabal, and he died.
